notes: Added 5 stories for EVAL-PROVIDER-LINKS covering schema, logic, API/UI, tests, and integration.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for external verification links
Added core logic story for link construction and labeling
Added API/UI exposure story via facade
Added unit tests for link generation and fallback handling
Added integration test for end-to-end delivery

stories.title: Define External Verification Link Schema
stories.description: Define structured schema for external verification links including source (Healthgrades, NPI Registry, State Board), URL, label, and guidance text for user interpretation.

stories.title: Implement Link Construction and Guidance Logic
stories.description: Implement logic to construct external URLs (Healthgrades, NPI Registry, state boards) and attach human-readable guidance explaining what each source represents and how to interpret it.

stories.title: Expose External Links via EvaluateCare Facade and UI
stories.description: Expose structured external verification links through evaluate_care_facade and ensure frontend renders them with clear labels and safe clickable links.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Link Generation and Fallback Handling
stories.description: Create unit tests to validate correct URL construction, label assignment, and graceful handling of missing state or NPI data.

stories.title: Integration Test for End-to-End External Link Delivery
stories.description: Validate that provider detail requests return fully structured external links from backend through facade to frontend rendering with no broken or missing links.
